annotations.title: Find places to submit a startup

description: Shortlist places to submit or launch a startup (directories, launch sites, communities, editorial sites) that fit a founder's product and limits. Use it when someone asks where to list, launch, or promote their startup or product. Returns a ranked list: Free with no catch first, then free with a catch, then paid by lowest listed price, then cost not on record. Within each group: shortest wait, then fewest unknown facts, then name. Never ranked by my own traffic results. Each result gives the cost and catch (cost, free), what the free path needs (needs), the wait, why it fits (why), which facts the query needs that are not on record (unknown), the list's notes, when it was last checked, and rowUrl, the place's row on the website. Leave out any filter that doesn't matter. Use get_directory for every fact about one place, and list_filters for allowed values and example arguments.

audience.description: Who the product is for. b2c drops places that only take business-to-business products (G2 and similar).

budget.description: The most the founder will pay for one listing, in USD unless currency is set. 0 means free paths only (free, and free with a catch). Leave out for any cost.

can_add_badge.description: false if the founder can't put a badge or backlink on their site. Default true.

cannot.description: Other requirements the founder can't meet: account, engagement (upvote, comment on, or rate other products first), socialProfile, phone, captcha, ownDomain, invitation, revenueProof. badge and domainEmail also work here.

categories.description: Only these sections of the list: directories, specialist (only for some startups), reddit, paid, problems.

country.description: Where the startup is based, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (AU, US, GB, IN); a country name such as Australia also works. Regional places limited to other countries drop out. Leave out for no region filter.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of budget. Default USD. Prices in another currency count as unknown.

domain_rating.description: The product site's domain rating, for places that set a minimum.

early_stage.description: true if the startup meets early-stage rules (for example under 5 years old, at most two institutional rounds).

formats.description: Only these listing formats: directory, launch (a dated launch), profile, editorial (a pitch for coverage), community (a post), app-review, review-site, gallery, beta-testing.

has_domain_email.description: false if the founder has no email address on the product's own domain (only Gmail or similar). Default true.

include_problem_sites.description: true to include places reported broken, inactive, closed, or dead. Default false.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

markets.description: Markets the founder wants to reach (ISO alpha-2 codes or country names), for regional sites that cover a market or language rather than requiring a headquarters there.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging. Default 0.

product_types.description: What the product is, as tags (see list_filters), for example ["web-apps"] or ["saas", "developer-tools"]. Give only tags that are true of the product: a product without AI features leaves out ai-tools, so places that only take AI products drop out. web-apps also counts as software and websites; saas also counts as software, web-apps, and websites. Without tags, places limited to some products count as unknown.

released.description: true if the product is publicly released and usable, false if it is pre-release or in beta.

strict.description: true to drop places where any fact the query needs isn't on record. Default false: they stay in, with the unknown facts listed.

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province, when a place is limited to one (US-WA). Implies the country.

within_days.description: The listing must go live within this many days on the free path. A place whose wait isn't on record counts as unknown.
